definition: CREATE TABLE smarter_private.hand_submission_resume_marks (table_id uuid NOT NULL, settled_through bigint NOT NULL, marked_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), CONSTRAINT hand_submission_resume_marks_pkey PRIMARY KEY (table_id));

CREATE TABLE smarter_private.retirement_original_hand_qualification (submission_id uuid NOT NULL, request_hash text NOT NULL, table_id uuid NOT NULL, tournament_id uuid NOT NULL, hand_number bigint NOT NULL, expected jsonb NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT retirement_original_hand_qualification_pkey PRIMARY KEY (submission_id), CONSTRAINT retirement_original_hand_qualification_table_id_hand_number_key UNIQUE (table_id, hand_number));
